title: French homework · Animal opinions
subject: French
summary: Understand the opinion symbols, build each sentence from reusable blocks, then write Ahmed, Ethan and Sophie’s answers.
contentHtml:
Your homework

What are you actually being asked to do?

For each person, write a couple of sentences. Start by saying the person's name with Je m’appelle…. Then describe their opinions of the pictured animals. Use mais (but) and et (and) to connect ideas.

Don't copy the model answers first. Work from the pictures and the sentence-building rules below.

Decode the pictures

1. The hearts are a strength scale

PictureFrenchMeaning
❤️❤️J’adore…I love…
❤️J’aime…I like…
💔 / crossed heartJe n’aime pas…I don't like…
two crossed heartsJe déteste…I hate…

Notice that ne … pas wraps around the verb in je n’aime pas. The e of ne disappears before the vowel in aime: ne aime → n’aime.

The reusable pattern

2. Build, don't memorise

Je m’appelleNAME.OPINIONANIMALmais / et …

Je m’appelle Ahmed. is literally “I call myself Ahmed”, but naturally means “My name is Ahmed.” Even though you are writing about Ahmed, the worksheet asks you to write as if you are Ahmed, so the subject remains je.

Then choose an opinion and animal: J’aime les chiens. Add a contrasting opinion with mais: J’aime les chiens mais je n’aime pas les poissons.

Animals

3. Retrieve the vocabulary

🐶les chiensdogs
🐟les poissonsfish
🐭les sourismice
🐱les chatscats
🐴les chevauxhorses
🐦les oiseauxbirds

These are plural groups of animals, so the worksheet uses les = “the”.

Connect the ideas

4. et or mais?

et = and. Use it when you are simply adding another idea.

mais = but. Use it when the second idea contrasts with the first: I like dogs but I don't like fish.

Before writing the French, say the meaning in English. Then build it block by block.

Worked example

5. Chantal

The sheet gives: Je m’appelle Chantal. J’adore les oiseaux mais je déteste les oiseaux.

Check the picture carefully: it appears to show Chantal loves birds but hates fish. If so, the printed example contains a typo and logically should end je déteste les poissons. Ask the teacher if the original sheet is clearer.

Final check

6. Before you copy it onto the worksheet

For every person ask: Did I start with Je m’appelle + name? Did I match the number/crossing of hearts to the right opinion? Did I use the right animal word? Did I use et or mais sensibly? Did I include capitals and full stops?

practice.name: Ahmed
practice.model: Je m’appelle Ahmed. J’aime les chiens mais je n’aime pas les poissons.

practice.name: Ethan
cues: two crossed hearts mice → je déteste
Use et to add the second negative opinion
practice.model: Je m’appelle Ethan. Je n’aime pas les chiens et je déteste les souris.

practice.name: Sophie
practice.model: Je m’appelle Sophie. J’adore les chats mais je n’aime pas les chevaux.
